thread.title: Paramount TV taps Nicole Clemens as its new president - MarketWatch

author: Sarah Toy
title: Paramount TV taps Nicole Clemens as its new president - MarketWatch
text:
Viacom's Paramount Pictures has chosen Nicole Clemens to be the TV unit's new president, according to a report published Wednesday in The Wall Street Journal. She will succeed Amy Powell, who was fired in July for allegedly making inappropriate, racially-charged remarks. Clemens is currently a senior executive at production company Anonymous Content, she set up TV series at Apple AAPL, -0.65% Netflix NFLX, -6.17% CBS Corp.'s CBS, +0.68% Showtime and Hulu. She was previously an executive at FX Networks, where she played a key part in developing acclaimed shows such as "Atlanta and "Better Things." In her new role, Clemens will report to chairman of Paramount Pictures Jim Gianopulos. "Nicole brings invaluable institutional experience and knowledge of all aspects of television from development to production to talent representation to programming," he said. Viacom VIAB, +0.17% shares have fallen 4.5% in the year to date, while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.28% has gained 8%.
